purpose: Teach: 双眼鏡/冷や汗/有難い/北口/出だし/オリジナリティ/平地/飛び降り

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、双眼鏡、絶対、で、絶対、鳥、絶対、観察してきたわ
lines.en: Sho, I really did go bird-watching with binoculars — I was totally serious about it.
lines.style: Warm, playful energy. Bright opening. Emphasizes 'totally serious' with a little lift, like she's proud of keeping a promise to him. Generous pace, easy breathing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、発表会で、絶対、冷や汗、絶対、かいちゃった
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really did break into a cold sweat during the recital — I was totally serious about being nervous.
lines.style: Small, dry delivery. Understated admission — not seeking pity, just stating fact. Slight pause before 'cold sweat' like he's almost embarrassed. Quiet, honest tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くんから、本気で、絶対、有難い、絶対、お言葉、絶対、メイ姉さん、絶対、励まされるよ
lines.en: Sho, the kind words from you really do encourage me — I'm being totally serious about that.
lines.style: Soft, genuine gratitude underneath. Not performing emotion. Slightly slower pace on 'kind words,' like she's letting that land. Warm exhale at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、駅の、絶対、北口、絶対、ぼく、絶対、待ってるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'll really be waiting for you at the north exit of the station — I'm being totally serious.
lines.style: Eager but grounded. Not breathless, but there's energy in it — he wants to make sure she believes him. Slight emphasis on 'north exit,' concrete and specific. Small-voiced sincerity.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さんの、本気で、絶対、お話の、絶対、出だし、絶対、いつも、絶対、緊張するわ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, the way I always start these conversations really does make me nervous — I'm not kidding about that.
lines.style: Wry, self-aware. Slight laugh underneath. She's poking fun at her own dramatic openings. Light and conspiratorial, like she's letting him in on the joke about herself.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さんの、本気で、絶対、絵には、絶対、オリジナリティ、絶対、あるよね
lines.en: Your paintings really do have their own style — there's something original there.
lines.style: Straightforward praise. Quiet certainty — not effusive, but genuine. Brief pause before 'original,' like he's chosen the word carefully. Kind, observant tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さんと、本気で、絶対、ふるさとの、絶対、平地、絶対、お散歩したいわ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, I really would love to take a walk through the countryside with you — I'm being serious about that.
lines.style: Soft, tender openness. Gentle pace. There's a vulnerability in wanting to share something quiet and personal with him. Warm and unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、ジャングルジムから、絶対、飛び降りる、絶対、と、絶対、お母さんに怒られちゃう
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really did jump off the jungle gym and got scolded by Mom for it — I'm being serious about that too.
lines.style: Dry, matter-of-fact. Small laugh running underneath — he's confessing a misdeed with wry acceptance. Quick pace on 'jumped' and 'scolded,' like he's rushing through the embarrassing part. Resigned but not sorry.
